key.name: finger-count
key.description: Number of fingers required for the app-switch swipe. Use 4 to leave native 3-finger workspace switching untouched.

key.name: invert-direction
key.description: Flip next/previous after applying the system natural-scroll setting.

key.name: swipe-threshold
key.description: Fraction of a full swipe required to commit the switch when velocity is low. Lower values are more sensitive.

key.name: animation-style
key.description: Live follows the fingers with window clones. Simple switches only when the gesture ends.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration in milliseconds for the finish (commit or snap-back) animation.

key.name: all-workspaces
key.description: If false, only applications with windows on the current workspace are included.

key.name: ignore-fullscreen
key.description: Do not start an app-switch gesture while a fullscreen window is focused.
